value.rationale: The new generalized Stieltjes coefficients lead to the intrinsic inverse problem of recovering all periodic data from finitely many local constants. This result proves the sharp q-1 information count uniformly in any positive shift, gives a strict infinite-family determinant inequality and a completely sharp positive-real zero budget, rather than re-evaluating known coefficients. It requires known period and mean-zero data, and gives no noise/conditioning guarantee.
